title: Cautions
chinese: 是故甚爱必大费，多藏必厚亡，知足不辱，知止不殆，可以长久。
pinyin: Shì gù shèn ài bì dà fèi， duō cáng bì hòu wáng， zhī zú bù rǔ， zhī zhǐ bù dài， kě yǐ zhǎng jiǔ。
english: Of fame or life, Which do you hold more dear? Of life or wealth, To which would you adhere? Keep life and lose those other things; Keep them and lose your life:⁠—which brings Sorrow and pain more near?
Thus we may see, Who cleaves to fame Rejects what is more great; Who loves large stores Gives up the richer state.
Who is content Needs fear no shame. Who knows to stop Incurs no blame. From danger free Long live shall he.
